SimCLR Contrastive Learning Framework

In Step 1, EfficientNet is pre-trained via self-supervised contrastive learning on 35,000 unlabeled images outside the plant disease dataset. In Step 2, the base model is fine-tuned with labeled plant leaf images, boosting private leaderboard accuracy from 0.93685 to 0.94686.
